account.title: Account
account.planFreeBody: Your current RVEEL experience is available without a paid subscription. Scanning, search, local history, favourites and published scores or signals are included when available for a product.
account.planFeatureScore: RVEEL Score and product signals when published
account.planFutureNote: Paid plans are not available in this build.
account.planPaidUnavailableNote: Paid plans, trials, billing and restore-purchase actions are not available in this build.
account.profileGuestBody: You can scan products and use RVEEL without creating an account. There is no signed-in customer profile in this MVP.
account.profileLocalStorageNote: Scan history, favourites, display settings and product cache are stored on this device where applicable. They are not cloud-synchronised and cannot be recovered through a login.
account.profileLimitsNote: Guest mode does not provide account recovery, cross-device sync, or a delete-account control. Clearing local data only affects this device.
account.privacyIntro:
RVEEL saves some information on your device, including your scan history, favourites, product cache and settings. Product lookups, sharing and optional contributions may also involve RVEEL services or independent providers.

Clearing data below removes the selected information from this device. It does not automatically delete data previously sent to RVEEL, Open Food Facts or another service, and it does not remove Evidence Authority contribution credentials.
account.privacyFootnote: There is no Delete Account control while Guest mode has no cloud account. Settings, inbound share attribution and contribution credentials are not removed by the clear actions above. Server-held personal information, if any, can only be pursued through a configured support contact — opening email does not confirm receipt or completion.
account.privacyRequestExplain: These actions open a draft email when a support contact is configured. They do not require a barcode or product photo. A deletion request is a request for review — it is not an automatic universal deletion of every record. Opening the draft does not mean RVEEL received or completed the request.
account.dataUseDeviceBody: Scan history, favourites, display settings and product cache can be stored on this device. They are managed locally and are not cloud-synchronised through a customer login in this MVP.
account.dataUseNetworkBody: Looking up a product may send barcode or search information to RVEEL services and independent catalogue providers so available product details can be retrieved. Lookups are functional requests, not a claim that every scan is stored as a permanent RVEEL account record.
account.dataUseSharingBody: If you share a product assessment, content leaves the app through your chosen share destination or a preview link. Shared content can persist outside RVEEL after you clear local history.
account.dataUseEvidenceBody: Where contribution features are available, you may submit evidence or photos. Public contribution of user photos to Open Food Facts remains disabled in this MVP until explicit consent controls are approved. Private Evidence Authority flows, when used, are separate from ordinary local clears.
account.dataUseBackendBody: Some features use RVEEL backend services for product assessment, publication checks, evidence handling or share previews. RVEEL may process technical and security logs needed to operate those services. Exact retention periods and hosting countries are not asserted here without verified configuration.
account.dataUseOffBody: Independent Open Food Facts catalogue information, including product data and imagery where present, is controlled by that project under its own licences and terms. Clearing RVEEL local data does not delete OFF catalogue records.
account.dataUseTelemetryBody: Optional share-event telemetry and local share analytics are gated and default off in this MVP. Essential product lookups and functional network requests can still occur when you use those features. There is no consumer consent toggle presented as a general analytics control in Account.
account.cameraPermissionNote: Camera and photo access are controlled by your device operating system settings. RVEEL does not provide a separate in-app override for those system permissions.
account.privacyUrlUnavailable: The public privacy policy is not available at {{url}} yet. In-app explanations here are not a substitute for an approved published Privacy Policy. RVEEL does not require an account. Local scan history, favourites and cache stay on this device unless you clear them.
account.legalUrlUnavailable: This document is not available at {{url}} yet. Draft Privacy and Terms are not treated as published. The page will open here only after an approved public publication.
account.legalOpenFailed: Could not open this document on this device. Please try again later.
account.legalIntro: Use this section to understand how RVEEL Score, Confidence, publication states and sources work. Public Privacy Policy and Terms pages remain unpublished until separately authorised.
account.legalSignalsNote: Dynamic Signals and food-recall notices are published separately from RVEEL Score and do not automatically change pillar scores.
account.understandingScoreBody: RVEEL Score is a governed comparative assessment. It uses four pillars — Body, Planet, Claims and Transparency — each contributing up to 25 points. Where publication rules allow, the overall result combines those pillars using external information and RVEEL's own governed rules. It is not independently laboratory-tested for every claim and is not a certification of health, safety, sustainability or ethics.
account.pillarBodyBody: Uses Nutri-Score/NOVA and governed food-additive inputs where available. It is not personal health advice and does not certify allergen safety.
account.pillarPlanetBody: Uses the governed Eco-Score pathway and limited packaging fallback methodology. It does not invent independent full carbon, water or lifecycle measurements.
account.pillarClaimsBody: Uses governed certification, benchmark and packet-claim evidence where applicable. External benchmarks do not endorse the RVEEL result merely because they appear as inputs.
account.pillarTransparencyBody: Assesses ingredient and origin disclosure evidence under defined rules. It does not mean every product fact has been independently established by RVEEL.
account.publicationRatedBody: A published pillar or overall assessment under existing rules. Only Rated outcomes may show score numbers and score colours.
account.publicationCheckingBody: Assessment is not yet settled. No overall number is displayed. Checking is not a final product outcome.
account.publicationNrBody: Required evidence is insufficient for a publishable overall score once the assessment is settled. NR is not a zero, a poor score, or an administrative hold.
account.publicationHoldBody: An authorised temporary withholding action that is separate from scoring, NR and Checking. It does not invent a synthetic score.
account.confidenceAccountBody: Confidence describes the strength and completeness of the evidence supporting a published RVEEL assessment under our methodology. It is not another product score, a measure of personal safety or a statistical probability that the assessment is correct. Overall Confidence reflects the weakest pillar confidence under RVEEL's governed rules.
account.sourcesStructuredOffBody: Product catalogue information may come from Open Food Facts. The OFF database uses ODbL, individual contents DbCL and product photographs CC BY-SA, subject to their terms. Attribution alone may not satisfy every reuse obligation.
account.sourcesStructuredImagesBody: Product images may be sourced through Open Food Facts under CC BY-SA where applicable. Native Share Cards do not currently render a dedicated on-card OFF licence line; web preview pages may show an attribution note when an image is present.
account.sourcesStructuredExternalBody: Nutri-Score, NOVA and Eco-Score pathways may inform assessments where applicable. Their presence does not mean those organisations endorse RVEEL.
account.sourcesStructuredRveelBody: RVEEL applies its own publication, Rateability and scoring rules to available evidence. Those rules are not the same as raw catalogue text.
account.sourcesStructuredBenchmarksBody: Benchmark and certification datasets may inform Claims where configured. Rights, mapping accuracy and endorsement implications remain subject to separate clearance. Restricted displays are not activated merely to complete this screen.
account.sourcesStructuredSignalsBody: Dynamic Signals and official recall information are separate publications. They do not automatically change RVEEL Score pillars.
account.limitationsIntro:
RVEEL assessments are provided to help users understand available food-product information and compare products under RVEEL's methodology.

They do not independently certify the safety, health effects, sustainability, ethical standards or suitability of a particular product.

Source information may be incomplete or outdated. Always check the current physical product packaging, particularly ingredients and allergens, and consult official food-safety notices where relevant.
account.correctionsBody: You can report factual concerns such as product identity, ingredients, origins, certifications, manufacturer associations, score explanations, signals or share content through Help & Support. A manufacturer or brand owner may request review of factual claims or supporting evidence. A review request does not automatically change RVEEL's independently governed assessment, remove third-party shares, or alter Open Food Facts records.

account.helpIntro:
Need help using RVEEL or found information that may be incorrect? Choose a topic below.

For product information or assessment concerns, include the product barcode and the information you believe needs review, where available.

Email actions open a draft message on your device. The message must be sent by you; opening the draft does not mean a report was received.
account.faqScoreHowBody: RVEEL Score is a governed comparative assessment across Body, Planet, Claims and Transparency. See Legal & Methodology for the accepted explanation of how scores are published.
account.faqNrWhyBody: UnRevealed means required evidence was insufficient for a publishable overall score after the assessment settled. It is not a zero score and not an administrative hold.
account.faqCheckingWhatBody: Checking means the assessment is not yet settled. No overall number is shown while Checking applies. Checking is not a final outcome.
account.faqConfidenceWhatBody: Confidence describes evidence strength and completeness for a published assessment under RVEEL rules. It is not another product score or a probability guarantee.
account.faqIncorrectWhy: Why might product information be incorrect?
account.faqIncorrectWhyBody: Catalogue data, packaging variants, outdated submissions and incomplete evidence can all produce mismatches. Always check the physical pack for allergens and ingredients.
account.faqCorrectionHow: How do I request a correction?
account.faqCorrectionHowBody: Use Report incorrect product information below when support is configured. Include the barcode and what appears wrong. A report does not automatically change a score.
account.faqNotMedical: Are RVEEL scores food-safety or medical advice?
account.faqNotMedicalBody: No. RVEEL assessments are comparative information tools, not medical advice, allergen certification or emergency food-safety guidance.
account.faqSignalsVsScore: How are Dynamic Signals and recalls different from scores?
account.faqSignalsVsScoreBody: Dynamic Signals and recall notices are published separately from RVEEL Score and do not automatically change pillar scores.
account.faqLocalStorageWhere: Where are my scans and favourites stored?
account.faqLocalStorageWhereBody: On this device. They are not recovered through a cloud login in this Guest MVP.
account.faqClearLocalHow: How do I clear my local data?
account.faqClearLocalHowBody: Open Account → Privacy & Data and use the separate clear actions for history, favourites or product cache.
account.faqAccountSubscribe: Can I create an account or subscribe?
account.faqAccountSubscribeBody: Not in this build. Guest mode has no cloud account, and paid plans, trials, billing and restore-purchase actions are unavailable.
account.faqCannotScan: What if I cannot scan a barcode?
account.faqCannotScanBody: Use Search or Enter Manually from Scan when available, and check camera permission in your device settings.
account.reportProductExplain: Report factual concerns about identity, ingredients, origins, certifications, manufacturer associations, assessments, signals or share content. Choose a concern type first. Optional pack photos may help; a report does not automatically change a score.
account.reportConcernSubtitle: Choose the closest match. Your choice is included in the email draft. Opening the draft does not mean RVEEL received a report.
account.reportConcernRecall: Incorrect recall or Dynamic Signal association
account.clearCacheCountUnknown: Clear the product cache on this device? The current cache count could not be read.
account.manufacturerExplain:
If you represent a manufacturer or brand owner and believe RVEEL has published inaccurate information about a product or company, you can request a review.

Please identify the product, the specific information in question and any evidence supporting the requested correction. RVEEL may need to verify your authority to represent the organisation before disclosing case information.

A request for review does not automatically change or remove an assessment.
account.technicalExplain: Report app problems such as crashes, scan failures or display issues. Do not include passwords, tokens or contribution credentials.
account.foodSafetyExplain: RVEEL is not an emergency food-safety reporting service. If you suspect a product presents an immediate safety risk, do not rely on a RVEEL score or wait for an email response. Check the product packaging and relevant official food-safety notices, and contact the appropriate authority or medical service where necessary.
account.recallOpenFailed: Could not open that official recall page on this device.
account.privacyFromHelpBody: For personal-information access, correction, deletion-review or privacy questions, use Account → Privacy & Data. Keep privacy requests separate from product-assessment reports.
account.aboutBody: RVEEL helps you review food products using governed scoring and separately published signals when available. Scores are comparative assessments, not guarantees of health, safety, sustainability or ethics. RVEEL is not a government recognition, certification authority, manufacturer sponsor or endorsement by external source organisations. Version {{version}}.

They reflect informational opinions only and may be incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated.
result.legalDisclaimerModalP3: Manufacturers and product packaging are the authoritative source of information for ingredients, allergens, nutrition, origin, and recalls. You must always read and follow the official product label and any applicable regulatory information before purchase or consumption.
result.legalDisclaimerModalP4: Rveel and its affiliates, licensors, developers, operators, and suppliers (collectively, "Rveel") make no warranty or representation, express or implied, as to the accuracy, completeness, reliability, timeliness, or fitness for a particular purpose of any content in this app.
result.legalDisclaimerModalP5: To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, Rveel disclaims all liability for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or exemplary damages, or any loss of profits, data, goodwill, or other intangible losses, arising from your access to or use of the app, or reliance on any score, insight, alert, or recommendation.
result.legalDisclaimerModalP6: You use Rveel voluntarily and at your own risk. Nothing in the app creates a duty of care or professional relationship between you and Rveel.
result.legalDisclaimerModalP7: If you have food allergies, intolerances, medical conditions, or specific dietary requirements, consult a qualified professional before relying on any product information in this app.

result.legalDataLimitationsModalP2: When information is missing or incomplete, Rveel may not display certain analyses, may reduce scores or adjust assessments, or may show cautionary messaging. These measures are informational only and do not assert that a product is safe, unsafe, healthy, or unsuitable for you.
result.legalDataLimitationsModalP3: Incomplete or missing data does not mean a product is free of allergens, additives, contaminants, or other issues; it only means the information was not available to the app at the time of display.
result.legalDataLimitationsModalP4: Rveel does not warrant that any product listing is complete, correct, or up to date. You remain solely responsible for verifying all information against the physical product label and packaging.
result.legalDataLimitationsModalP5: To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, Rveel disclaims liability for any reliance on incomplete or missing data shown in the app.

result.palmOilFlagsDescription: Understanding palm oil flags helps you make informed choices. Each flag represents a different level of environmental impact and sustainability.
result.greenFlagDescription: This product does not contain palm oil or palm oil derivatives. Products with a green flag have no palm oil content, making them the most environmentally friendly option. By choosing palm oil-free products, you help reduce the demand for palm oil plantations, which are a leading cause of deforestation, biodiversity loss, and climate change. This is the best choice for environmental sustainability.
result.orangeFlagDescription: This product contains palm oil, but its sustainability status is unknown or not verified. Palm oil itself is not inherently bad - when produced sustainably, it can be an efficient crop. However, the majority of palm oil comes from unsustainable sources. The orange flag indicates that the product contains palm oil, and you should look for additional information such as RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil) certification to ensure it comes from responsible sources.
result.redFlagDescription: This product contains palm oil that is likely from non-sustainable sources. Products with a red flag have been identified as containing palm oil that may contribute to deforestation, habitat destruction, and environmental degradation. This is the most concerning category, as non-sustainable palm oil production is one of the leading causes of rainforest destruction, particularly in Indonesia and Malaysia. Purchasing these products directly supports practices that threaten endangered species like orangutans, tigers, and elephants, while also contributing significantly to climate change.
result.benefitNoHabitatLoss: No habitat destruction for endangered species
result.lookRSPOCert: RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil) certification
result.rspoInfo: RSPO Certified palm oil ensures no deforestation, no peat development, and fair labor practices.

result.redFlagWarning: Consider choosing palm oil-free alternatives or products with verified sustainable palm oil (RSPO certified) to minimize environmental impact.
result.palmOilInfo: Palm oil is a vegetable oil derived from the fruit of oil palm trees. It is widely used in processed foods, cosmetics, and cleaning products due to its versatility and low cost. However, its production has significant environmental and social impacts when not managed sustainably.
result.palmOilNote: Making informed choices about palm oil can help protect our planet and its wildlife. When possible, choose products with sustainable palm oil or palm oil-free alternatives. Your choices matter in the fight against deforestation and climate change.

nutrition.burnStripSubtitle: Per 100g of this product consumed, a rough exercise equivalent is estimated below. (Note: this does not constitute medical advice. This information is shown for approximate comparison only.)
nutrition.burnStripA11y: Per 100 grams consumed, approximate activity equivalents: about {{walk}} minutes walking, {{run}} minutes jogging, or {{cycle}} minutes cycling.
nutrition.burnModalHeroSub: Approximate exercise equivalent for a {{weightKg}} kg reference adult
nutrition.burnModalHeroFootnote: These are approximations for comparison only — not exact energy burn or medical guidance.
nutrition.burnModalHeroA11y: {{name}}. {{kcal}} kilocalories per 100 grams. Approximate exercise: {{walk}} minutes walking, {{run}} minutes jogging, {{cycle}} minutes cycling.
nutrition.burnModalSourcesBody: We follow the same foundation used by researchers, health apps, and many fitness devices: the Compendium of Physical Activities (Ainsworth et al.) for MET values, interpreted in line with American College of Sports Medicine (ACSM) practice for energy expenditure estimation.
nutrition.burnModalMetsBody: A MET (Metabolic Equivalent of Task) compares activity to resting metabolism: 1 MET is roughly the energy you use at rest. Each activity is a multiple of that baseline. We use standard MET ranges from the Compendium for walking, jogging, and moderate cycling.
nutrition.burnModalActivitiesTable:
Walking (~5 km/h): 3.5 METs
Jogging (~8 km/h): 7–8 METs (we use 7.5 for calculation)
Cycling (moderate): 6–8 METs (we use 7)
nutrition.burnModalFor70kg: For a 70 kg adult, that gives about 4.3 kcal/min walking, about 9.2 kcal/min jogging, and about 8.6 kcal/min moderate cycling — close to the rounded rates (5 / 10 / 8) many apps show for readability. We compute minutes from your product’s kcal per 100 g using the MET-based rates above.
nutrition.burnModalHybridBody: Pure MET math is defensible but busy on a small screen; flat numbers alone are hard to justify. We use the MET formula with reference METs and a 70 kg reference mass, then present rounded minutes with the ≈ symbol so it is clear these are estimates for comparison — not exact calorie burn or a prescription.
nutrition.burnModalRealityBody: Even gold-standard methods vary with weight, fitness, terrain, and efficiency. No app can truthfully promise "exact" burn time. We frame this as estimated effort to compare products, not a command about what you must do.
nutrition.burnModalPositionBody: We use Compendium MET values, aligned with ACSM-style energy estimation, to approximate kcal per minute at a reference body mass, then translate food energy per 100 g into simple exercise equivalents for understanding and comparison.
nutrition.burnModalDisclaimer: For personal diet or exercise advice, speak with a qualified health professional. This feature is for education and product comparison only.
nutrition.burnSharePrefill: Per 100 g, "{{name}}" ≈ {{kcal}} kcal — estimated ≈ {{walk}} min walking, ≈ {{run}} min jogging, or ≈ {{cycle}} min cycling (MET-based estimate, 70 kg reference; not medical advice — for comparison only).

trustScore.title: Understanding Rveel Score
trustScore.description: Rveel Score is an assessment of food products across four equally weighted pillars: Body, Planet, Claims and Transparency. Each pillar contributes up to 25 points towards an overall score of 100.
trustScore.howItWorksText: Rveel combines available product information, recognised external assessment systems and Rveel's own defined scoring rules. These rules determine how nutritional, environmental, certification, ingredient and origin information contributes to the assessment.
trustScore.whenScoreShownText: Rveel publishes an overall score only when all four pillars have sufficient information to be rated and the assessment is complete. If information is still being checked, the score remains hidden. If a pillar cannot be rated because the required information is insufficient, the overall score remains UnRevealed (NR).
trustScore.confidenceMeaningText: Confidence indicates the strength and completeness of the evidence supporting a published assessment, according to Rveel's defined criteria. It is not a separate product score or a statistical guarantee of accuracy. Overall Confidence derives from the weakest pillar confidence under Rveel's governed rules.
trustScore.methodologyLimitationsText: Rveel provides general information and comparative assessments, not medical advice or product certification. Product information may be incomplete, outdated or incorrect. Always check the physical product packaging for ingredients, allergens and nutrition information, and consult official regulatory notices for recalls and safety warnings.
trustScore.formula: Rveel Score = Body (2-25) + Planet (0-25) + Claims (0-25) + Transparency (0-25) = 0-100 when all four pillars are Rated. Body has a minimum floor of 2.
trustScore.step1: Calculate Body score (2–25) using Nutri-Score, NOVA classification, and food additives of concern when evidence is present. Minimum floor of 2 applies under the Body rules.
trustScore.step2: Calculate Planet score (0–25): Eco-Score v19 when grade exists; otherwise packaging fallback (+2/+1/0) per Annex v2. Palm does not change the Planet score in MVP.
trustScore.step3: Calculate Claims score (0–25) from a 15 base, then BBFAW (animal welfare), KnowTheChain (labour / supply chains), eligible certifications (highest scheme only — Fairtrade +6, Rainforest Alliance/UTZ +6, ASC +4, MSC +4, Organic +2; RSPO does not score), and packet-claim assessment where applicable. Certification bonuses are not stacked.
trustScore.step4: Calculate Transparency score (0-25) from ingredient-list disclosure evidence and origin completeness where available
trustScore.step5: Sum all four pillars: Rveel Score = Body + Planet + Claims + Transparency (0-100 total). An overall numeric score is published only when all four pillars are Rated.
trustScore.sustainabilityDesc: Evaluates environmental impact, including carbon footprint, water usage, packaging sustainability, and agricultural practices. Higher scores indicate more sustainable production methods.
trustScore.ethicsDesc: Assesses Claims using BBFAW animal-welfare signals, KnowTheChain labour/supply-chain benchmarks, eligible certifications (highest scheme only), and packet-claim assessment where applicable. Higher scores reflect stronger Claims outcomes under Rveel's rules.
trustScore.nutritionDesc: Measures nutritional quality based on ingredients, additives, nutrient density, and health impacts. Focuses on whole foods, minimal processing, and beneficial nutrients.
trustScore.bodySafetyDesc: Body uses Nutri-Score and NOVA when available, plus a governed food-additives-of-concern registry when evidence is present. Allergen information may be shown for awareness but is not a Body scoring input. Higher Body outcomes reflect stronger results under Rveel's Body rules, not a guarantee of personal safety or health.
trustScore.processingDesc: NOVA classification informs Body processing assessment when available. Other manufacturing details listed for context are not independently scored unless covered by the Body rules.
trustScore.transparencyDesc: Transparency assesses ingredient-list disclosure and origin completeness where structured evidence is available. Missing required evidence can leave a pillar UnRevealed (NR) rather than simply lowering a published number.
trustScore.excellentDesc: When published, scores in this band indicate a relatively strong combined assessment under Rveel's methodology. A high overall total does not mean every pillar is equally strong, and it does not certify that a product is healthy, safe, sustainable, or ethically assured.
trustScore.goodDesc: When published, scores in this band indicate a relatively favourable combined assessment under Rveel's methodology. They do not mean most or all pillars are strong, and they are not guarantees of product quality or suitability.
trustScore.fairDesc: When published, scores in this band indicate mixed or moderate outcomes under Rveel's methodology. They do not mean a product is unsafe or unsuitable.
trustScore.poorDesc: When published, scores in this band indicate relatively weaker outcomes under Rveel's methodology. They do not by themselves prove a product is unsafe, unhealthy, or unsustainable.
trustScore.note: Rveel Score uses Open Food Facts product information together with recognised external assessment systems and Rveel's own governed scoring and publication rules across Body, Planet, Claims, and Transparency. An overall numeric score is published only when all four pillars are Rated. Rveel explains its assessment approach but does not promise that every consumer can independently reproduce every calculation.
trustScore.dataSourceNote: Score inputs: Open Food Facts product information (world.openfoodfacts.org); Rveel's governed assessment rules; and relevant certification and benchmark datasets (for example BBFAW and KnowTheChain where configured). Dynamic Signals and food-recall notices are separate from Rveel Score.
trustScore.scoringDescription: When published, Rveel Score ranges from 0-100, with each of the four pillars contributing up to 25 points. Higher scores indicate stronger outcomes under Rveel's assessment rules across Body, Planet, Claims and Transparency.
trustScore.dataSourcesDescription: Rveel Score combines Open Food Facts product information, recognised external assessment systems, and Rveel's own defined scoring rules. Below are the active inputs and methods for each pillar:
trustScore.transparencyNote: External standards such as Nutri-Score, NOVA and Eco-Score inform the assessment where available. Rveel applies its own governed rules to produce pillar scores and to decide when an overall score may be published.
trustScore.bodyDesc: Evaluates nutritional and composition signals for food and beverage products using Nutri-Score and NOVA when available from Open Food Facts, plus a governed food-additives-of-concern registry when evidence is present. Higher scores indicate stronger Body outcomes under the current AU/NZ F&B methodology.
trustScore.planetDesc: Planet v19: Open Food Facts Eco-Score drives the score when a grade exists (A +7 … E −7 from a 15 base). If Eco-Score is missing, a small packaging fallback (+2/+1/0) uses structured packaging and AU/NZ kerbside rules (Annex v2). Palm oil is shown for transparency but does not change the Planet score in MVP.
trustScore.ethicsDesc: Assesses Claims from a 15 base using BBFAW (animal welfare), KnowTheChain (labour / supply chains), eligible certifications at the highest scheme only (Fairtrade +6, Rainforest Alliance/UTZ +6, ASC +4, MSC +4, Organic +2; RSPO does not score), and packet-claim assessment where applicable. Certification bonuses are not stacked. The pillar is floored at 0 and capped at 25.
trustScore.openDesc: Evaluates how clearly the product discloses what is in it and where it comes from, using the ingredient list and available origin evidence. Missing required evidence can leave Transparency UnRevealed (NR) rather than simply lowering a published number. Higher scores indicate clearer, more complete disclosure under Rveel's rules.
trustScore.dataQualityDescription: Confidence indicates the strength and completeness of the evidence supporting a published assessment, according to Rveel's defined criteria. It is not a separate product score or a statistical guarantee of accuracy.
trustScore.confidenceScoreCalculationDesc: Overall Confidence derives from the weakest pillar confidence according to Rveel's governed rules. It reflects evidence strength and completeness for a published assessment — not a second numeric score or probability of correctness.
trustScore.highConfidenceDesc: Stronger evidence completeness under Rveel's confidence criteria for the published assessment.
trustScore.mediumConfidenceDesc: Moderate evidence completeness under Rveel's confidence criteria. Some fields may still be limited.
trustScore.lowConfidenceDesc: Weaker evidence completeness under Rveel's confidence criteria. Treat the assessment as less well supported and verify important details on the pack.
trustScore.confidenceScoreNote: When an overall score is published, Confidence appears with that score. It is not a second product score and does not guarantee accuracy.
trustScore.flagsDescription: Some items below can adjust a published pillar score under Rveel's rules. Others are contextual information or separate Dynamic Signals and do not automatically change Rveel Score.
trustScore.flagsDescriptionForProduct: Product-specific scoring factors and related signals for this assessment:
trustScore.redFlagsDesc: Items that may contribute to weaker pillar outcomes under Rveel's rules, leave evidence insufficient for publication (NR / Checking), or appear as separate safety Signals:
trustScore.greenFlagsDesc: Items that may contribute to stronger pillar outcomes when the relevant governed evidence is present. Not every listed topic is independently scored:
trustScore.flagGeopoliticsDesc: Missing or unclear structured origin evidence can leave Transparency incomplete or UnRevealed (NR). It is not treated as an automatic numeric penalty on a published overall score.
trustScore.flagNegativeNewsDesc: Active food-recall notices may appear as Dynamic Signals or safety alerts. They are separate from Rveel Score and are not score deductions. Always verify official regulatory notices.
trustScore.flagBoycottDesc: Incomplete ingredients, nutrition, or other required evidence can prevent a pillar from being Rated and may keep the overall score UnRevealed (NR) or hidden while Checking — rather than simply reducing a published number.
trustScore.flagSustainabilityIssuesDesc: Planet is driven by Eco-Score grade adjustments when a grade exists, or by the limited packaging fallback when Eco-Score is absent. Broad carbon, water, deforestation, or plastic concerns are not each scored independently in MVP beyond those rules. Palm oil is display-only on Planet.
trustScore.flagEthicsIssuesDesc: Claims uses BBFAW (animal welfare), KnowTheChain (labour / supply chains), highest eligible certification only, and packet-claim assessment where applicable. Broad labour or welfare wording outside those implemented benchmarks does not automatically reduce the score.
trustScore.flagNutritionIssuesDesc: Weaker Nutri-Score outcomes and food additives of concern (when evidence is present) can lower Body under Rveel's rules. Sugar/salt and similar nutrients are reflected through Nutri-Score where available, not as separate standalone deductions.
trustScore.flagProcessingIssuesDesc: Higher NOVA groups (when available) can lower Body under Rveel's rules. Other manufacturing details are contextual unless covered by Body inputs.
trustScore.flagSustainabilityPositiveDesc: Stronger Eco-Score grades raise Planet when a grade exists; otherwise only the packaging fallback can apply. Low carbon, renewable energy, or organic farming are not independent Planet bonuses beyond those rules.
trustScore.flagEthicsPositiveDesc: Stronger Claims outcomes come from BBFAW, KnowTheChain, highest eligible certification (Fairtrade +6, Rainforest Alliance/UTZ +6, ASC +4, MSC +4, Organic +2; no stacking), and packet-claim assessment where applicable — not from every ethical label in general.
trustScore.flagNutritionPositiveDesc: Stronger Nutri-Score outcomes (when available) raise Body under Rveel's rules. Separately, a governed Whole Produce +7 Body adjustment may apply only when no valid Nutri-Score exists and the product passes the Whole Produce eligibility gate (including NOVA 1 and qualifying fresh produce evidence). Generic 'whole food' or health-benefit claims are not themselves a scoring bonus.
trustScore.flagProcessingPositiveDesc: Lower NOVA groups (when available) support stronger Body outcomes under Rveel's rules. Freshness or traditional methods are not independent scoring inputs beyond NOVA/Body rules.
trustScore.flagCertificationsDesc: Eligible Claims certifications can raise Claims using the highest eligible scheme only (Fairtrade +6, Rainforest Alliance/UTZ +6, ASC +4, MSC +4, Organic +2). Certification bonuses are not stacked. RSPO does not contribute Claims points.
trustScore.flagPositiveReviewsDesc: Clearer ingredient disclosure and origin evidence support Transparency assessment. Richer data does not automatically add bonus points outside the Transparency rules, and missing required evidence may yield NR rather than a lower published score.
trustScore.novaClassificationDescription: NOVA is a food classification system that categorizes foods according to the extent and purpose of processing. It helps identify how processed a food is and its impact on health.
trustScore.novaNote: NOVA classification helps identify how processed a food is. Generally, less processed foods (NOVA 1-2) are better for health than ultra-processed foods (NOVA 4).
trustScore.nova1Description: Unprocessed or minimally processed foods. Natural foods that have been cleaned, dried, frozen, pasteurized, or undergone minimal changes that do not add substances.
trustScore.nova1Examples: Fresh fruits, vegetables, nuts, seeds, grains, fresh meat, fish, milk, eggs, water
trustScore.nova1Benefit1: High nutritional value and natural nutrients preserved
trustScore.nova1Benefit2: No added preservatives, additives, or artificial ingredients
trustScore.nova1Benefit3: Best choice for health and nutrition
trustScore.nova2Description: Processed culinary ingredients. Substances extracted or derived from natural foods, used in cooking to prepare and season dishes.
trustScore.nova2Examples: Vegetable oils, butter, salt, sugar, honey, vinegar, herbs, spices
trustScore.nova2Benefit1: Used in moderate amounts for cooking and flavoring
trustScore.nova3Description: Processed foods. Foods made by adding salt, sugar, oil, or other processed ingredients to natural or minimally processed foods to increase shelf life or improve taste.
trustScore.nova3Examples: Canned vegetables, fruit in syrup, cheese, bread, smoked meats, pickled foods
trustScore.nova3Concern1: May contain added salt, sugar, or preservatives
trustScore.nova3Concern2: Moderate nutritional value depending on ingredients
trustScore.nova4Description: Ultra-processed foods. Industrial formulations made entirely or mostly from substances extracted from foods, with little to no intact food remaining. Often contain many additives.
trustScore.nova4Examples: Soft drinks, packaged snacks, instant noodles, ready meals, reconstituted meat products, sweetened breakfast cereals
trustScore.nova4Concern1: High in added sugars, salt, unhealthy fats, and additives
trustScore.nova4Concern2: Low in fiber, vitamins, and natural nutrients
trustScore.nova4Concern3: Associated with health risks including obesity and chronic diseases
trustScore.nova4Concern4: Often contains artificial flavors, colors, and preservatives

ecoscore.title: Understanding Eco-Score
ecoscore.description: The Eco-Score is an environmental impact rating (A to E) that measures a product's ecological footprint based on life cycle assessment. It helps you choose products that are better for the planet.
ecoscore.whatItMeasuresText: The Eco-Score evaluates the environmental impact of a product from production to consumption, including farming, processing, packaging, transport, and disposal. It considers multiple environmental factors to provide a comprehensive assessment. Eco-Score data is provided by Open Food Facts and is based on the Agribalyse LCA database from ADEME (French Environmental Agency).
ecoscore.formula: Eco-Score = Base Score (CO₂: 40%, Water: 20%, Deforestation: 20%, Biodiversity: 20%) + Bonus/Malus adjustments
ecoscore.step1: Base score calculated from life cycle assessment (LCA) data
ecoscore.step2: Each environmental factor is weighted and combined
ecoscore.step3: Bonus points added for organic, local, or eco-friendly certifications
ecoscore.step4: Malus points deducted for packaging issues or problematic ingredients
ecoscore.gradeADesc: Excellent environmental performance. Minimal impact on ecosystems, climate, and resources. Best choice for the planet.
ecoscore.gradeBDesc: Good environmental performance with low to moderate impact. Sustainable production methods and efficient resource use.
ecoscore.gradeCDesc: Average environmental impact. Some areas for improvement but generally acceptable ecological footprint.
ecoscore.gradeDDesc: High environmental impact. Significant concerns regarding resource use, emissions, or ecosystem damage.
ecoscore.gradeEDesc: Very high environmental impact. Major concerns across multiple environmental factors. Consider alternatives.
ecoscore.co2Desc: Measures greenhouse gas emissions throughout the product's life cycle, from production to disposal. Lower CO₂ values indicate better climate impact.
ecoscore.waterDesc: Evaluates water consumption and water pollution during production. Considers both direct water use and indirect impacts on water resources.
ecoscore.deforestationDesc: Assesses the risk of contributing to deforestation, especially for products containing palm oil, soy, or cocoa. High risk indicates potential impact on forests and biodiversity.
ecoscore.biodiversityDesc: Measures the impact on species diversity and ecosystem health. Considers agricultural practices, land use, and potential harm to wildlife and natural habitats.
ecoscore.note: The Eco-Score is provided by Open Food Facts and is based on the Agribalyse LCA database from ADEME (French Environmental Agency). Eco-Score is available for food products in the Open Food Facts database. Scores may vary based on data availability and regional production methods. For cosmetics and personal care products, sustainability data (palm oil, packaging) is shown instead.
ecoscore.flagsDescription: Understanding what factors negatively and positively impact a product's Eco-Score:
ecoscore.redFlagsDesc: These factors decrease a product's Eco-Score and indicate environmental concerns:
ecoscore.greenFlagsDesc: These factors increase a product's Eco-Score and indicate positive environmental attributes:
ecoscore.flagGeopoliticsDesc: Products with long transport distances or unclear origin information may have higher environmental impact. Transport penalties are included in Eco-Score calculations.
ecoscore.flagNegativeNewsDesc: Products with active food recalls from the FDA are flagged for safety concerns. Recall information is checked for food products and displayed prominently.
ecoscore.flagBoycottDesc: Products with incomplete environmental data (missing LCA data, packaging info, or ingredient analysis) may have less accurate Eco-Scores.
ecoscore.flagSustainabilityIssuesDesc: High carbon footprint, deforestation, excessive water usage, plastic packaging, or poor environmental practices negatively impact Eco-Score.
ecoscore.flagEthicsIssuesDesc: Poor labor conditions, lack of fair trade practices, animal welfare concerns, or supply chain transparency issues reduce environmental scores.
ecoscore.flagNutritionIssuesDesc: High levels of additives, artificial ingredients, excessive sugar/salt, or low nutritional value negatively affect Eco-Score.
ecoscore.flagProcessingIssuesDesc: Ultra-processed foods (NOVA 4), excessive processing, artificial preservation, or manufacturing concerns reduce Eco-Score.
ecoscore.flagSustainabilityPositiveDesc: Low carbon footprint, renewable energy use, sustainable packaging, organic farming, or positive environmental impact increase Eco-Score.
ecoscore.flagEthicsPositiveDesc: Fair trade certifications, ethical labor practices, animal welfare standards, or transparent supply chains positively impact Eco-Score.
ecoscore.flagNutritionPositiveDesc: Whole foods, minimal processing, natural ingredients, high nutritional density, or health benefits improve Eco-Score.
ecoscore.flagProcessingPositiveDesc: Minimally processed (NOVA 1-2), fresh ingredients, traditional methods, or natural preservation techniques increase Eco-Score.
ecoscore.flagCertificationsDesc: Organic, Fair Trade, B-Corp, Rainforest Alliance, or other ethical/environmental certifications add positive points to the Eco-Score.
ecoscore.flagPositiveReviewsDesc: Products with complete environmental data (full LCA data, packaging recyclability, palm oil analysis, carbon footprint) provide more accurate Eco-Scores.
